page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on a KVM hypervisor using x86_64 architecture. It is built with 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, yielding a 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The hardware configuration provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance includes no direct local SSD or NVMe storage bundled with the deployment, requiring attached network volumes for disk persistence. It also does not feature graphics processing unit acceleration.

Without local storage, storage operations rely completely on remote cloud disks, which represents a structural tradeoff between data persistence flexibility and local I/O performance. The balanced allocation of compute and memory makes this instance type cost-effective for general enterprise application servers, mid-tier web serving, microservice hosts, and container orchestration.
